data.one_liner: Measures duration of synchronous and asynchronous actions with optional JSON serialization.
data.what_it_does: Provides trackers to time code blocks and collect detailed timing slices. Supports both sync and async actions and can serialize results via json_serializable.
use_when: You need lightweight performance timing in Dart/Flutter code
You want JSON‑serializable timing data for logging or analytics
avoid_when: You require visual profiling charts or deep flame‑graph analysis
You need a full‑featured benchmarking suite
strengths: Handles both sync and async actions
Integrates with json_serializable for easy data export
weaknesses: Limited to basic timing, no advanced profiling features
Requires build_runner step for code generation
data.setup_notes: Run `dart pub run build_runner build` to generate serialization code
